about_the_game: Andromis is a third-person action-adventure where you play as two characters who share connected missions across a massive story. Across 50 missions, you’ll collect items, drive vehicles, rescue survivors, and fight robots in explosive battles. Switch between characters, use powerful weapons like flamethrowers, and unlock tanks and armed vehicles as you progress through the story.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains frequent violence, including shooting enemies and hostile human enemies. Players will see blood, gore, and dismemberment during battles. The story also includes themes of government conspiracy and survival in a post-apocalyptic setting.

short_description: Play as two heroes a soldier and a doctor in a third-person action adventure packed with explosions, vehicles, and survival missions. Switch between characters, drive cars and tanks, rescue survivors, and fight deadly robots across 50 story missions in a post-apocalyptic world. Coming in January.
